summary: Mode/flag switch with a return code. With a2 == 0 it resets this+0x128 to 1 and clears this+0x12C/0x130 to 0, returning 0. With a2 non-zero, if this+0x128 is already 2 it returns 2 without changing state (redundant-activation guard); otherwise it sets this+0x128 to 2, this+0x12C to 1, this+0x130 to 1 and returns 1. Called by PitStopDecisionTireCompound, PitPartStateCopy, CollisionSparkParticleEffects, ActorMotionPostProcessingUpdate and RepairServiceStateDispatcher.

local_names.this: state object holding mode and flags
local_names.a2: activation request flag (0 = reset, non-zero = activate)

operations.description: Branch on the activation request a2: when zero the reset path runs, otherwise the activation path
Reset path: writes this+0x128 = 1, this+0x12C = 0, this+0x130 = 0 and sets the result to 0
Redundant-activation guard (this+0x128 != 2): when the mode is already 2 the state-change block is skipped and the result is 2
Activation path: writes this+0x128 = 2, this+0x12C = 1, this+0x130 = 1 and sets the result to 1

Returns 0 (reset), 1 (activated) or 2 (already active); called by PitStopDecisionTireCompound (0042A3D0), PitPartStateCopy (004A5330), CollisionSparkParticleEffects (004EC1A0), ActorMotionPostProcessingUpdate (004ED030) and RepairServiceStateDispatcher (004ED250)
